definition.prompt: Using the uploaded product photo, design a 3-by-3 campaign contact sheet. Keep the container, label and brand palette consistent across all nine panels. Use this campaign palette: sage green, ivory and brushed silver. In reading order the nine panels show: hero shot; cap and label close-up; hand holding the bottle; brushed metal detail; three-bottle repeated arrangement; floating bottle; paint texture macro; bottle beside leaves; bottle on a picnic table. Use coherent lighting, even gutters and a 4:5 canvas.

review.notes: Exactly nine panels preserve the sage bottle, silver cap and PINE label. The specified hero, close-up, hand interaction, material, repeated arrangement, floating, paint macro, leaves and picnic scenes are present.
